verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly list 'Reader SDKs' as one of three in-person integration paths and state you can 'Embed payment acceptance directly in your Android or iOS app,' confirming official mobile SDK support exists alongside Tap to Pay and offline transaction handling. However, the evidence pack contains no iOS/Android-specific install instructions, package names, or code samples (only JavaScript SDK code is shown), so depth of documented mobile integration is thin. Missing for 10: iOS SDK (CocoaPods/SPM) setup docs, Android SDK (Gradle) setup docs, mobile-specific code samples, and independent developer corroboration of SDK usability.
